title: Final Reflection Angle
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly express the reflection angle theta_R in terms of theta_I and beta.

title: Final Transmission Angle
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly express the transmission angle theta_T in terms of theta_I, beta, and the indices of refraction.

title: Reflection Coefficient
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the reflection coefficient R correctly in terms of the incident angle and beta.

title: Transmission Coefficient
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the transmission coefficient T correctly as T = 1 - R.

title: Field Transformation
description: Important Criteria: The student must show understanding of how to transform the electric and magnetic fields between frames.

title: Common Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes when applying the Lorentz transformation to the angles and coefficients.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the derivation.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss limiting cases, such as beta approaching 0 or 1, to validate their results.
